To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we found a somatic mutation of the NF2 tumor suppressor gene in a pediatric meningioma with a deletion of chromosome 22, while no germ-line or somatic mutation of NF2 was found in pediatric rhabdoid tumor, ependymoma or malignant glioma.

(1) a mutation was detected in a pediatric meningioma with a loss of chromosome 22; (2) no mutations were identified in 2 rhabdo/ATT and 7 ependy tumors, suggesting the existence of a different tumor suppressor locus; and (3) a deletion in the NF2 locus was found in a patient with a rhabdo/AT tumor, but no tumor tissue was obtained.

1) the NF2 gene is involved in the genesis of some pediatric meningioma, 2) the NF2 locus may not be involved in the genesis rhabdoid tumor and ependymoma, 3) the NF2 germ line is not involved in the genesis ependymoma.
